skills.description: Lookback (lookback.com) platform help — a self-serve, video-first user research platform for live/moderated studies: real-time interviews and usability tests with observer rooms (\\\"behind the glass\\\"), timestamped notes and findings, highlight reels, unmoderated self-tests with AI follow-ups, mobile screen-and-gesture recording via the Participate app, transcripts, and Eureka AI analysis. It has no participant panel of its own (recruit via User Interviews or bring your own) and is UI-first — no self-serve REST API/webhooks, only a partner Recruitment API and an MCP/Discover surface. Use when setting up a Lookback moderated interview or usability study, fixing participant no-shows from the Chrome plugin or Participate-app install, debugging dropped connections or audio/video cutting out mid-session, or picking a plan by sessions. Do NOT use for comparing research tools or the validate-before-building method (use /sales-idea-validation), or existing NPS/CSAT feedback (use /sales-customer-feedback).
